visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young child with black pigtails, dressed in a bright orange dress over a yellow short-sleeved shirt, stands with her back to the camera. She is facing a large, light-brown wooden sliding door with grid-patterned glass panes. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor home setting. (2) The child suddenly spins around to face the camera, opening her mouth wide in a dramatic shout. Her facial expression is exaggerated and intense. Red digital laser beams emit from her eyes, and small pink heart icons float outward from the center of the screen. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the child's chin and neck area. A black 'I' symbol is drawn on her chin, and the words 'see you' are written in black ink just below her bottom lip. (4) The child appears again in a medium close-up, now with flesh-colored tape covering her eyebrows and dark red lipstick applied. She moves her head and shoulders rhythmically to an upbeat tempo, staring directly at the camera with a serious yet comedic expression. (5) Pink neon heart-shaped circles appear around the child's eyes as she continues to move her face and body to the beat of the music. The wooden door remains the consistent background throughout these edits.
